name: crank-mods
description: Offers the next crank or crank-lite command a hand-off printed as the prompt's Tab suggestion after /clear or a restart, and draws a band above the prompt for a running crank-execute or lite-execute: a header with the task position, stage, landed count and bound, and a row per crank agent with its role, task, effort, elapsed time and current tool

hud.title: Run band
hud.description: Draw a band above the prompt while crank-execute or lite-execute runs: the task position, the stage, the landed count, the bound the run wrote, and how the run ended, then a row per crank agent with its role, task, effort, elapsed time, and current tool or the background shell it waits on.

resume.title: Resume suggestion
resume.description: Keep the next-phase command a crank or crank-lite hand-off prints, per worktree for 12 hours, and offer it as the prompt's Tab suggestion after /clear, at startup or --resume, and after /model, /effort or /config.
